;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Operation Northern Shield]]
**Israel announces an operation to clear [[Hezbollah]] tunnels from Lebanon-Israeli border. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-launches-operation-on-lebanon-border-to-destroy-hezbollah-attack-tunnels (''The Times of Israel'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Citizenship of Russia|Russians]] vote to rename the two main airports of [[Moscow]], [[Sheremetyevo International Airport|Sheremetyevo]] and [[Moscow Domodedovo Airport|Domodedovo]], after  poet [[Alexander Pushkin]] and scientist [[Mikhail Lomonosov]], respectively. [http://tass.com/society/1034348 (TASS)] 

;Law and crime
*The alleged boss of the [[Sicilian Mafia|Cosa Nostra]] mafia clan is arrested along with 45 suspected accomplices in the [[Metropolitan City of Palermo|province of Palermo]], [[Italy]]. They are accused of aggravated extortion. [https://www.euronews.com/2018/12/04/new-mafia-boss-settimo-mineo-arrested-in-raid (Euronews)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**Following large protests against French President [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s planned increases on [[fuel tax]]es, French Prime Minister [[Édouard Philippe]] announces that these plans will be suspended for at least six months. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-12-04/french-govt-to-suspend-fuel-tax-to-end-yellow-vests-protest (Bloomberg)]
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom]] is found to be in [[contempt of parliament]] for the first time in history. The motion, which passed by 311 to 293 votes in the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]], was triggered by [[Theresa May]]'s government failing to publish its legal advice on its [[Brexit]] withdrawal plan. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/04/uk/brexit-legal-advice-contempt-of-court-gbr-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Frank Scott Jr.]] is elected Mayor of [[Little Rock, Arkansas]], defeating Baker Kurrus in the runoff. Scott will become the city's first African-American mayor.  [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2018/12/05/little-rock-arkansas-elects-frank-scott-first-black-mayor/2212383002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Sports
* [[Potential National Hockey League expansion|NHL expansion]]
** In [[ice hockey]], the [[National Hockey League]] announces that its board of governors unanimously approved a [[Seattle NHL team|new franchise]] for [[Seattle]]. The new team will start play in the 2021–22 season, bringing the league's membership to 32 teams. [http://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/25451216/nhl-votes-give-expansion-franchise-seattle (ESPN)]
